title: 24 Days of Play Winter Countdown for Ages 2-5, Printable Toddler Activity Cards, Cozy Indoor Ideas, Screen-Free, Letter and A4 PDF
category_hint: Toys & Games > Toys > Learning & School (or 'Advent calendars' is NOT used: the countdown is secular) — UNVERIFIED
description:
24 winter plays for ages 2–5, one a day. It is a printable PDF in US Letter and A4, with color and low-ink files.

Winter days can be long and dark. Each card gives the day one small, warm play: paper snowball toss, a blanket bear cave, an ice rescue, a flashlight shadow show, a cozy book nest. 22 of the 24 use only things most homes have.

Every card shows a starting age in months, prep, mess and a rough play time. It has short steps, one thing to say while you play, an easier way, a harder way, a 2-minute version for tired days and its own safety line.

Hang the countdown board and color a circle after each play. Or skip the cutting and read each day from the list page. Start any day, skip days, or play a favorite twice.

It is a winter countdown for any family: snow, cold and long nights. It is not tied to any holiday or faith.

You get a 2-page grown-up guide, safety rules, a what-you-need list, a blank board, 24 number tags and a fridge certificate. Type in the blank board and certificate with a free PDF reader.

Every play follows our published safety rules. Digital file in English; nothing is shipped. Personal license for one household.

PREP: About 15 minutes once to print and cut the 12 card pages and the tags. Each day 0–5 minutes (one play is frozen the night before, about 2 minutes). No-cut option: hang the board and read each day from the list page.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 24 winter plays for ages 2–5, one a day, on 12 half-page card pages. Each 25-page file also has a guide, safety rules, boards, tags and a certificate.
• Every card shows a starting age, prep, mess and play time, short steps, a talk line, easier and harder versions, a 2-minute version and a safety line.
• 22 of the 24 plays need nothing to buy. About 15 minutes to print and cut once; most days take 0–5 minutes to set up.
• Five plain PDFs: START HERE, color and low-ink, each in US Letter and A4. Type in the blank board, hunt tick boxes and certificate.
• A secular winter theme for any family. Start any day and play in any order. Every play follows our published safety rules.

HOW TO DOWNLOAD
After you pay, open Etsy in a web browser (not the app), go to You > Purchases and download the files. Start with START HERE. Print at 100% / Actual size.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Personal license for one household. Please don't resell or share the files.
• Every play follows our published safety rules, with a grown-up there for every play.
• Digital download: nothing ships. Printed words are in English.
• Digital downloads can't be returned once downloaded. If a file won't open or print, or doesn't match this description, message us through Etsy and we'll fix it or refund it.
